entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: internal invariant violated: %s is not a label-only mixed set-op consumer
entries.rationale: labelCallOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp admits only label_replace and label_join before calling lowerLabelCallOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp, the same arity/name gate histogram_native_label_replace.go's identical labelCallOverExpHistogram/lowerLabelCallOverExpHistogram pair carries for the pure-histogram case. Since cerberus issue #2528, lowerMixedExpHistogramFamily replaces lowerRoot as the direct caller (split out of lowerRoot's own body purely to keep that function's golangci-lint maintainability-index score over the repo's floor) — the same labelCallOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp-matched Call flows through unchanged, so the claim is unaffected.

guard: default of switch call.Func.Name over [case fnLabelReplace; case fnLabelJoin; default]
